title: Genesis – Software Implementation Consultant (Summer 2027)
description:
Are you a highly motivated individual with a passion for the latest engineering and manufacturing software trends including cloud-based solutions? Can you guide customers through complex digital transformations? Are you looking for a fast-paced high growth career?

If so, please apply for this outstanding opportunity at Siemens Government Technologies!

Our Customers …

Many companies are partnering with Siemens Government Technologies to build their Comprehensive Digital Twin; the virtual representation that gives them the capability of linking design and virtual simulations to physical engineering and manufacturing. Our customers are in the Federal and Aerospace and Defense Industries, where this technology gives them a competitive advantage. These customers are selecting Siemens Government Technologies because we have the comprehensive Digital Twin capabilities, available today – from concept through manufacturing into field maintenance.

Your Challenge …

Can you be a creative and independent domain specialist?

Become a member of our SGT Digital Solutions Outcome team as an Implementation Consultant for our Genesis Program. You will start by attending our June 2027 Genesis Program. Through this program, you will undergo 4 months of training that will provide you with the tools needed to contribute to customer projects. After completing the Genesis Program, you will begin working closely with customers to provide software solutions to help them realize their Comprehensive Digital Twin. Helping our customers blur the boundaries between industry domains by integrating the virtual and physical, hardware and software, design, and manufacturing worlds.

Responsibilities:

Collaborate with industry experts to learn our best practices
Core participant in estimating, planning, and scheduling deliverables, and tasks
Play a key role in developing change initiatives for our customers to increase their efficiency and productivity
Impact our customers’ initiatives and business drivers
Accelerate development in architectural design to fulfill customers’ business requirements
Provide support to control scope, cost, implementation, and quality
Consult with users, management, and stakeholders

Requirements:

Graduated from college with a degree in Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Fall 2026 or Spring 2027)
University undergraduate with a minimum 3.0 GPA
Exceptional communication skills
Driven and self-motivated
Strong technical leadership skills
Ability to obtain Security Clearance
Able to relocate if needed
Traveling up to 75% after training program 
Successful completion of the 16-week training course

Location:

Services candidates will be required to reside in Mason, OH from June 2027 to October 2027 for their Genesis Training Program. Depending on project assignment after Genesis, there is a possibility that you may need to move to key customer locations.

Security Clearance:

Candidate must be a United States Citizen with no dual citizenship and have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance and access to special access programs
